
{{alias}}( list, name, fields )
    Converts a list of arrays to a "tidy" data set.

    The function assumes that all arrays in the provided list have the same
    length.

    The number of field names should equal the number of arrays in the
    provided list.

    Parameters
    ----------
    list: ArrayLikeObject<ArrayLikeObject>
        List of arrays.

    name: string
        Data set name.

    fields: Array<string>
        List of field names.

    Returns
    -------
    out: DataSet
        Data set instance.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = [ 1, 2, 3 ];
    > var y = [ 4, 5, 6 ];
    > var out = {{alias}}( [ x, y ], 'data', [ 'x', 'y' ] )
    <DataSet>

    See Also
    --------
